title: More Stuff+
description: Adds More stuff to Minecraft - For NeoForge 1.21.1
body: More Stuff+ is a Vanilla-Enhancing mod which just adds random stuff as i think of it, for example it has Nether Emerald Ore which drops Emerald Nuggets. This mod is currently in early development and will recieve updates soon. It is an expansion of everything, but not at a high quality (for now) It will adds tools and armour, more woodtypes, more biomes, more dimensions and such. It is in early beta right now so content is scare, everything will be updated as the project expands.
